1. Site boundaries and the 23.00 × 5.00 m garden corridor are
taken from the client's survey sketch. All boundary
dimensions to be confirmed by measured survey before any
2. Blocks A and B sit hard against the north, east and west
boundaries. The south elevation onto the garden is the
only open facade, so a 2.65 × 2.48 m light court is cut
through all three storeys to daylight the centre of the
3. The ground floor sits 0.50 m above the garden, reached by
three risers at 167 mm at the entrance and at the patio
doors. Surface water to a soakaway within the planted
4. No part of the new work oversails or undermines the
adjoining plots; party wall notices to be served on the
north, east and west owners before excavation.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
